entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: ...Hey.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Have you seen that Phantom Aficionado[n]Website?
...What site?
I've heard of it.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'm the one who started it.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Um...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: ...You guys are the Phantom Thieves,[n]aren't you?
Give me some space.
What?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: ...Sorry.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Although... if things really are as I think,[n]I should keep it a secret.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Kamoshida used me, and I did some[n]horrible things to you guys.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: This isn't much of a way for me to[n]apologize for it...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: But if there's anything I can do to help,[n]just let me know!
That's great, but...
This is a misunderstanding.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'm glad to hear that.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: That's... all I needed to say.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: It's not just Kamoshida... There are[n]tons of evil adults out there.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: But I'm sure the Phantom Thieves will do[n]something... They can't let this end after[n]just one target.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: That's why I wanted to make a forum[n]where people could post their problems.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: There are probably a lot of people who[n]have high hopes for the Phantom Thieves'[n]next move.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: So I've also implemented an anonymous[n]poll on the site.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: "Do you believe in the Phantom Thieves[n]or not?"

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I wanna work on this forum so eventually[n]it'll be packed with tons of supportive[n]posts.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'd really like to help out in the Phantom[n]Thieves' acts of justice! Can I, please?
Sounds like fun.
It's up to you...
Do what you want.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'll live up to your expectations... I promise.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: *chuckle* In that case, I'll just do what[n]I want.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Yeah, I will.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Besides the public's reaction to your[n]group, there were others who supported[n]you.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Someone who enthusiastically cheered[n]the Phantom Thieves on. Perhaps they[n]were quite close...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...What do you have to say to that?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You have agreed to a new[n]contract. Excellent.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Use that bond to gather the voices of[n]those who yearn for your help.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: ...See you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We heard all that.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Geez... It was a little awkward tryin' to[n]figure out when to walk over here.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So that forum is Mishima-kun's...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Has he figured out our identities?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Even so, I think it'll be fine. He seemed to[n]be playing it cool.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I guess we should have a little chat about[n]this later.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I will say though... a forum where[n]people can post problems may prove[n]unexpectedly useful.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Anyways, we gotta get lookin' for a new[n]target.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And we need to stay sharp until[n]we manage to find one.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Once we do, we'll have to head into[n]another Palace, so we should prep[n]our equipment and—

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, oh CRAP!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What's with you!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't we have an exam comin' up!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Judging by that reaction, I'd assume[n]you're going to struggle this time too?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's not like you're any better! All you're[n]good at is... English!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'd rather that than be bad at every[n]subject!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Even your Japanese is questionable[n]at best, Ryuji.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What's questionable is whether you're[n]really even a human.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ha! Good comeback, huh?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Let's discuss this with our fists!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Bring it!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Will you two stop it!?
I sense abundantly high[n]expectations from Mishima...
